user_story: As a user, I want to receive an error message when I enter an invalid email format during registration so that I know to correct it.

positive.title: User enters a valid email format during registration
steps: Enter a valid email format, e.g., user@example.com, in the email field.
Complete the rest of the registration form and submit.
positive.expected_result: The user successfully registers without any error messages.

negative.title: User receives an error message when entering an email without an '@' symbol
steps: Enter an email without an '@' symbol, e.g., userexample.com, in the email field.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the email format is invalid.

negative.title: User receives an error message when entering an email without a domain
steps: Enter an email without a domain, e.g., user@.com, in the email field.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the email format is invalid.

negative.title: User receives an error message when entering an email without a top-level domain
steps: Enter an email without a top-level domain, e.g., user@example., in the email field.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the email format is invalid.

edge.title: User receives an error message when entering an email with consecutive dots
steps: Enter an email with consecutive dots, e.g., user..example@example.com, in the email field.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the email format is invalid.

edge.title: User receives an error message when entering a minimal email format
steps: Enter a minimal email format, e.g., a@b.c, in the email field.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the email format is invalid.
